name: sparkbtcbot-reset-ledger
description: Name-reservation stub for a RETIRED sparkbtcbot command. `sparkbtcbot-reset-ledger` was a bin in sparkbtcbot-skill 0.4.x-0.5.x; 0.6.0 replaced it with `sparkbtcbot reset-ledger`. This package exists so a bare `npx sparkbtcbot-reset-ledger` — typed from memory or an old doc — resolves to project-owned code that refuses and explains, instead of a squatter's, at wallet-bootstrap time.
author: Eric Chennells
